songs.title: Neon Current
songs.description: The original. Warm synths, a steady heartbeat, and that familiar drop.

songs.title: Chrome Circuit
songs.description: Punchy kicks, clipped bass, and bright electric hooks.

songs.title: Midnight Drive
songs.description: Syncopated drums and a late-night, neon-lit melody.

songs.title: Solar Flare
songs.description: Soaring arpeggios, rising energy, and a wide-open drop.

songs.title: Terminal Velocity
songs.description: Rapid breaks, deep bass, and the fastest track in the collection.

levels.name: Easy
levels.hint: More room to breathe. Single notes and gentle holds.

levels.name: Arcade
levels.hint: The classic mix. Taps, holds, and two-note chords.

levels.name: Expert
levels.hint: Offbeats, quicker patterns, and less breathing room.

levels.name: Master
levels.hint: Four keys pushed further. Sixteenth-note bursts, jumps, and fast streams.

levels.name: Overdrive
levels.hint: Six keys. Relentless streams and three-note chords. Keyboard recommended.
